notes:
Account: Converso Peak Solutions - multi-tenant contact center provider serving telco and retail verticals. Primary ask: robust agent-assist + ticket summarization with predictable behavior during incident bursts and seasonal peaks.

POC scope: 2-week focused POC (agent assist endpoints + tool-calls for case updates). Objective: validate spike reliability (target 5k concurrent assistant sessions, occasional bursts to 12k/min), graceful degradation (fallback to distilled model + partial responses) and end-to-end latency SLOs (median <120ms, p95 <400ms).

Security: must integrate with customer SSO (SAML), KMS for keys, audit logs retention 12 months; want private deployment option (VPC) for PII workloads. Data residency: EU-sensitive customer base requires EU-region hosting for certain tenants.

From initial calls: "We need the system to not collapse when our campaign spikes — history of queue backpressure last holiday season was painful." — VP Ops. Cost sensitivity high for hosted API; open to Dedicated with commit if unit economics validated.

- SE demo 2026-02-18 (Marco) covered routing/fallback and canary rollouts.

- POC env reqs: synthetic load generator, KV cache priming, prefix caching enabled, prioritization policy per SLA.
- Proposed fallback: route non-critical summarization to quantized 4-bit model during spikes; keep high-priority agent-assist on higher-tier model.
- Concerns: session affinity for agent context, KV cache warmup time, GPU capacity scheduling during bursts.
